{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if recent history shows strong upward momentum and sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Cap upward spikes above 10% of recent 30-day average to prevent overshoots in bullish sentiment periods.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 5% above true outcome for 3 consecutive days, reduce by 0.5–1.0% per day.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is low (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to avoid overfitting to recent noise.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment changes from 0.00 to >0.25, adjust forecast upward by 1–2% of recent 30-day mean.",
    "For high sentiment (sentiment > 0.25), apply a 10% smoothing filter to prevent erratic short-term spikes."
  ]
}
